tasks.title: N01 graph: dependency change impact
tasks.purpose: Find every component that directly or indirectly depends on a changed component and needs to be processed again.
tasks.input: graph.bin contains node, edge and query counts, (depender, dependency) pairs, and query roots, all encoded as little-endian u32 values.
tasks.task: Build reverse dependency adjacency once, then run a separate BFS for every root. Include the root, handle cycles and repeated edges, and visit each reachable node once per query. Cached answers or component-level shortcuts cannot replace the required traversals.
tasks.output: Concatenate one affected-node bitmap per query in query order. The checker compares every bit, including unused trailing bits.
tasks.focus: Graph traversal, index access, integer conditions and bitmap updates.

tasks.title: N03 events: streaming transaction state machine
tasks.purpose: Process transaction events for multiple accounts or sessions, maintain independent state, and reject duplicate or invalid events.
tasks.work: 100,000 events, 10 independent keys; 32 bytes per record, 3,200,000 input bytes.
tasks.input: Each record contains timestamp, key, sequence, amount and kind. Read in file order using bounded chunks rather than loading the entire event file.
tasks.task: Maintain START/CHARGE/COMMIT/CANCEL state per key. Deduplicate by sequence first, process timeouts beyond 30,000 time units next, then apply the event. Negative charges and illegal transitions count as invalid. Retain state across batches.
tasks.output: Emit final state, pending amount, last sequence, and duplicate/timeout/invalid/completed/cancelled/total fields in key order. The checker compares every field.
tasks.focus: Streaming file I/O and decoding, conditional branches, and repeated updates to a small state table.

tasks.title: N04 simulation: integer queue trajectories
tasks.purpose: Simulate many independent work queues with capacity 64 and count completed, expired and capacity-rejected work.
tasks.work: 10,000 trajectories × 256 steps, 2,560,000 state updates in total.
tasks.input: Initial u32 seeds are stored in seeds-{batch}.bin; the program generates events with its PRNG.
tasks.task: At each step, perform the u32 PRNG multiply/add modulo 2^32, then enqueue, complete or expire work. Record rejection when the queue is full. Execute every step of every trajectory; cached answers or formulas cannot skip the loops.
tasks.output: Emit [final queue length, completed, expired, rejected] as four little-endian u32 values per trajectory. The checker compares every value in original seed order.
tasks.focus: Large volumes of u32 arithmetic, wrapping semantics and loops with frequent branches.

timingBoundaries.validatedMs: daemon startup through model generation, all cells/repairs/final replies and external checker; excludes fixture generation and teardown
timingBoundaries.validatedWithoutAllCompilationMs: per-run union of verified Cargo/AOT command intervals clipped to validated boundary then deducted once; includes LLM; arithmetic deduction, not a compiler-free run
timingBoundaries.validatedWithoutCompilationAndModelMs: For each run, clip verified Cargo/AOT commands and all gateway model-request intervals to the validated boundary, merge them and deduct once, then take the median of successful samples. Overlap is not deducted twice. The remainder includes host startup/dispatch, runtime/I/O, snapshots, the checker and inter-request gaps. This is an arithmetic adjustment of the original E2E trace, not a model-free run or pure compute. Missing complete intervals, unique request IDs or a shared clock make the value unavailable.
timingBoundaries.adjustmentEvidence: In JSON, validatedModelMs is the model-request interval union within the validated boundary; validatedCompilerAndModelMs is the combined deduction; validatedCompilerModelOverlapMs is their overlap. The LLM request sum may count concurrent requests and must not be subtracted directly.
timingBoundaries.llmMs: sum of all gateway request receipt-to-stream-end durations, including errors/retries; excludes gaps between requests; may overlap cell execution
timingBoundaries.codeEmissionMs: sum of generated code field first-to-last SSE event intervals; nested within LLM time, not additional time or provider CPU
timingBoundaries.codeReadyMedianMs: within-run median request receipt-to-last-source-field SSE event, including wait before first code byte
timingBoundaries.executionMs: sum of runtime-reported execution durations across all measured cells, including runtime errors, excluding Cargo/AOT; generated code and cell count can differ
timingBoundaries.cargoMs: union of captured Cargo command intervals within validated boundary, including initialization and failed builds
timingBoundaries.aotMs: union of captured AOT command intervals within validated boundary; union with Cargo only deducted once
timingBoundaries.tokens: provider-reported input/output usage summed over every request; Anthropic input includes uncached, cache creation and cache read tokens, with native usage retained; unavailable if any request lacks valid usage

comparisonLimits: Generated programs and cell counts vary; offline versus e2e runtime differences do not establish a language speed ratio.
